literal_meaning: পাকা বা দৃঢ় (solid or fully cooked/mature)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাজমহল বানাতে পাক্কা বিশ বছর লেগেছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: It took a full twenty years to build the Taj Mahal.
This plan is now fully set.
history: Often illustrated with the historical construction of the Taj Mahal, which exemplifies full completion over time.
note: The idiom conveys thoroughness and is widely used in Bengali to denote something entirely finished or reliable.
